title: cachelint golden-fixture suite file (cases.json)
description: Documentation-grade schema for the per-suite cases.json files. Inputs and case names are HAND-WRITTEN; every `expected` block (and the report/cli *.golden.txt files) is MACHINE-GENERATED by scripts/gen-cachelint-fixtures.py from the Python reference engine and hand-reviewed before commit. `expected: null` marks a case whose golden output has not been frozen yet.

target.description: The Python reference entry point the generator runs for this suite.

name.description: Unique within the suite; used as the test id in both SDKs.

description.description: What behavior this case pins (mention the SPEC delta letter when applicable).

input.description: Suite-specific input. detectors: {text}. resolve: {provider, model}. tokenize: {text, provider_key, upstream}. canonical: {prompt}. analyze/sequence/report: {data} inline or {input_file} relative to the fixtures dir. errors: {data}. cli: {argv, stdin_file?} — argv paths are relative to the fixtures dir, which is the subprocess cwd.

expected.description: Machine-generated golden output. null until frozen. detectors: {findings, first_blocking_index}. resolve: {provider_key, min_tokens, tier_note, warnings, upstream} or {error}. tokenize: {tokens, method, exact, note}. canonical: {text, sections, non_text}. analyze: the full analyze() result. sequence: the sequences array. errors: {error}. report: {golden: '<file>.golden.txt'}. cli: {stdout_golden, stderr, exit_code}.

stderr_parser_specific.description: cli suite only: the stderr text comes from the argument parser (argparse / node:util parseArgs), which differs across languages AND Python versions — conformance asserts only exit_code and stdout for this case; expected.stderr stays null.
